rooms.name: Ground Floor
rooms.description: White smoke hangs in the air. A wine bottle lies beside a locked metal chest.

items.name: newspaper
items.description: A recent newspaper suggests that someone still lives here.

containers.name: chest
containers.description: A scratched metal chest with a rusted lock.

use.message: The rusty key opens the chest. A revolver drops onto the floor.

equipment.name: revolver
equipment.description: An old revolver with six rounds.

use.message: The cylinder turns smoothly; all six chambers are loaded.

rooms.name: Ruined Kitchen
rooms.description: Broken cupboards and shattered plates cover the floor.

exits.name: south
exits.description: The door back to the ground floor.

exits.name: east
exits.description: A narrow doorway to a bedroom.

rooms.name: Abandoned Bedroom
rooms.description: Clothes are scattered across an unmade bed, as if the owner left in a hurry.

exits.name: west
exits.description: The doorway back to the kitchen.

exits.name: north
exits.description: Stairs climb toward a wooden corridor.

rooms.name: Wooden Corridor
rooms.description: The floorboards creak beneath every step.

items.name: stick
items.description: A sturdy wooden stick that could serve as a tool or weapon.

exits.name: south
exits.description: The stairs descend to the bedroom.

exits.name: east
exits.description: A damaged door opens into another bedroom.

rooms.name: Locked Bedroom
rooms.description: Dust covers the furniture, but a wooden chest has recently been moved.

containers.name: chest
containers.description: A wooden chest secured with a crude wire latch.

equipment.name: wire
equipment.description: A short length of stiff iron wire.

use.message: The wire releases the latch. A bottle of medicine is hidden inside.

equipment.name: medicine
equipment.description: An unlabelled bottle of red pills.

use.message: The faded label warns that the medicine may cause memory loss.

exits.name: west
exits.description: The damaged door returns to the corridor.

exits.name: north
exits.description: A quiet passage leads toward a study.

rooms.name: Vanished Study
rooms.description: The room's far wall is missing. Wind carries a voice from the courtyard below.

items.name: note
items.description: The note mentions an experiment conducted upstairs.

containers.name: voice
containers.description: The voice repeats a name that feels strangely familiar.

exits.name: south
exits.description: The passage returns to the bedroom.

exits.name: east
exits.description: A service door opens into a storeroom.

rooms.name: Unusual Store
rooms.description: The room is unexpectedly luxurious compared with the rest of the house.

items.name: pen
items.description: A fountain pen engraved with the initials S. K.

containers.name: case
containers.description: An empty glass case stands under a bright lamp.

exits.name: west
exits.description: The service door leads back to the study.

exits.name: north
exits.description: A narrow stairway rises to a workplace.

rooms.name: Workplace
rooms.description: A stained uniform hangs beside a desk covered in laboratory records.

items.name: uniform
items.description: The name stitched onto the uniform is your own.

exits.name: south
exits.description: The stairway descends to the storeroom.

exits.name: north
exits.description: A final staircase leads into the attic.

rooms.name: Attic Laboratory
rooms.description: A table holds a sealed letter and the remains of a medical experiment.

containers.name: letter
containers.description: The letter explains why your memories were erased.

exits.name: south
exits.description: The staircase returns to the workplace.

exits.name: east
exits.description: A pale light shines through the rooftop door.

rooms.name: Rooftop
rooms.description: Cold daylight breaks through the smoke. For the first time, you can see beyond the house.

containers.name: memory
containers.description: Fragments of the experiment return as you look over the ruined city.

exits.name: west
exits.description: The rooftop door leads back to the laboratory.
